m01_last_call.title: Last Call
m01_last_call.summary: Marcus comes home bleeding. The city starts keeping score.

stages.text: Get to Mama Ruth's before closing.
Hear Marcus out.
Marcus needs 400 by Friday.

options.label: Give him the money
Refuse. He has to face it.

stages.text: Something's wrong out back. Move.
Ruth saw who took him.

m02_the_book.title: The Book
m02_the_book.summary: Crowe's ledger is the only language he respects. Find what Marcus owes — and to whom.

stages.text: Mags hears everything. Ask about the ledger.
How do you get 3,000 by Friday?

options.label: Ask Roz for work (Ashfall Syndicate)
Work it off legit. Jobs and jobs.
Shake down Julian's collectors

stages.text: Raise 1,500 credits (any way you can).
Buy Marcus's note location from the Crowe clerk.

m03_berth7.title: Berth 7
m03_berth7.summary: Roz pays for quiet hands and a fast back. Tonight the docks are not quiet.

stages.text: Take Roz's job.
Move the crate van to Yard 4. Don't stop for anyone.
Police sweep ahead. Decide fast.
Blue lights in the mirror.

options.label: Dump the cargo, keep the license
Run the blockade

stages.text: Finish the run.

m04_crowe_credit.title: Crowe Credit Co.
m04_crowe_credit.summary: Silas Crowe never raises his voice. He doesn't need to.

stages.text: The office. Third floor. Mind the carpet.
Sit down with Silas.
He offers terms.

options.label: Pay Marcus's note (1,500)
Beg a week
Put a hand on his desk and threaten him

stages.text: Whoever bought the note wants a word.

m05_static.title: Static
m05_static.summary: An old voice on a new phone. Tess Marlowe doesn't call by accident.

stages.text: Answer the unknown number.
Noir Lounge. Back booth.
Let her talk. Then decide how much you believe.
She wants the drive Marcus stole.

options.label: Work with Tess
Refuse. Halcyon gets nothing.

m06_the_shelter.title: The Shelter
m06_the_shelter.summary: Bishop Achebe hides people the way the refinery hides smoke: badly, and for money.

stages.text: Bishop's shelter, Slagworks.
He's hiding someone who saw the grab.
Okoro's sweep hits the block.
The witness is in your hands.

options.label: Give Okoro the witness (clean, on record)
Spirit them out through the slag tunnels

stages.text: Marcus stashed the drive in the chapel organ.

m07_yard4.title: Yard 4
m07_yard4.summary: Eight men, one purse, no referees. Gunnar calls it 'budget planning'.

stages.text: Fight night at Yard 4.
Bout 1: the Dockhand.
Bout 2: 'Hinge' Malloy.
Bout 3: whoever Julian paid.
Julian Crowe crashes the purse.

m08_halcyon_tower.title: Halcyon Tower
m08_halcyon_tower.summary: Forty floors of glass and arithmetic. ARGUS counts footsteps.

stages.text: Plan the lift with your contact.
Get to floor 31 without tripping ARGUS. A Charcoal Suit would help you blend in.
Copy the shell-company filings.
ARGUS knows. Tess says leave the original.

options.label: Take the original anyway
Leave it. The copy is enough.

stages.text: Security escort. Be polite. Be fast.

m09_the_exchange.title: The Exchange
m09_the_exchange.summary: A brother for a drive, at the refinery gate. Everyone brings extra friends.

stages.text: Refinery gate. Midnight.
Julian didn't come to trade.
Get the truth out of your brother.

m10_smoke_line.title: Smoke Line
m10_smoke_line.summary: Halcyon's bulldozers idle at the Kiln Row line. Count them, take their order, kill their plant, and hold the alley until they run out of people to send.

stages.text: Get to Ruth's. The word is going round the row.
Gunnar and the haulage crews.
Roz's people, if they'll stand.
Watch the bulldozer line. Count the crew before you commit.
Okoro, if the badge still fits.
A Halcyon surveyor is running with the demolition order. Get it back.
stages.name: Halcyon Surveyor

stages.text: Kill the bulldozers. Three charges on the plant line, then clear the blast.
Hold the line until Halcyon's muscle runs out of people.
How does this end?

options.label: Expose Halcyon at the plaza hearing
Burn Crowe's ledger and own the underworld
Take Vivian's deal. Save the row, sell the rest.

m11_the_leverage.title: The Leverage
m11_the_leverage.summary: Founders Plaza. Every debt in one room — and a freight train between you and it. Beat the smoke line, count the room, then keep the badge breathing.

stages.text: Okoro wants a word before you walk into that room.
Beat the freight across the smoke line to the Furnace.
Count Vivian's people from the tower steps. Know the room before you enter it.
Whatever's left of Julian's people.
Julian is going up the tower with the shredder keys.
Keep Okoro alive long enough to read the warrants.
stages.name: Det. Okoro

stages.text: Vivian offers you the pen.

options.label: Sign
Tear it up

m12_everyone.title: Everyone Has Leverage
m12_everyone.summary: After. Count the trains from the overlook with your brother, eat too much at Ruth's, and decide what happens to every debt in Cinder City.

stages.text: Smoke Line Overlook. One last walk.
Your brother is already up there.
Count them, like you did when you were eight.
Back down to the row. Ruth made too much food again.
Sit down. Eat. Be told the truth about your brother.
Crowe's ledger is in your coat. What kind of person does that make you on Thursday?

options.label: Burn it. Nobody owes anybody.
Keep it. Someone has to hold the book.
Give it to Okoro. Daylight, on the record.

side_courier.title: Hot Lane
side_courier.summary: Dex needs a driver who doesn't ask.

stages.text: Take Dex's run.
Deliver in under 90 seconds.
The consignee just ran off with the package.
stages.name: Consignee

stages.text: Back to Dex. He will not ask, but he will look.

side_race1.title: Quay Sprint
side_race1.summary: Four checkpoints along the quay. Pride is the purse.

stages.text: Dex is holding a car at the garage.
Take the briefing. All two sentences of it.
Win the Quay Sprint.

side_race2.title: Furnace Loop
side_race2.summary: Through the towers, against traffic, allegedly legal.

stages.text: Meet at Pawn 24H. Nobody asks why.
Win the Furnace Loop.
Lose the heat and be back at the garage in 95 seconds.

side_nightshift.title: Night Shift
side_nightshift.summary: Walk the clinic's patients home. The city objects.

stages.text: Take the shift.
Get two patients home safely.
Someone followed the last one home. Keep Nia standing.
stages.name: Dr. Okonkwo

stages.text: Walk Nia back to the clinic door.

side_dockwork.title: Crate Count
side_dockwork.summary: Move eight crates before the manifest deadline.

stages.text: Berth 7. The manifest closes at six.
Gunnar has instructions and he will repeat them.
Move 8 crates to the manifest line.

side_fightclub.title: Open Ring
side_fightclub.summary: Yard 4 takes bets on anyone with hands.

stages.text: Fight night at Yard 4.
Mags does the wraps and the briefing.
Win an open-ring bout.
The ring wants a second round. Give it one.

side_ledger.title: Torn Pages
side_ledger.summary: Crowe's ledger pages surface all over. Mags buys silence.

stages.text: Mags buys silence out the back.
Hear the rate. It never changes.
Recover ledger pages (0/12).

side_favors.title: Favor Economy
side_favors.summary: Twenty tokens of goodwill keep a neighborhood breathing.

stages.text: Ruth keeps the row's books in a kitchen.
Take the list. Sit down first.
Collect favor tokens (0/20).

side_ghost.title: Ghost Work
side_ghost.summary: Dex knows a warehouse patrol that never should have seen the ledger. Clear it quiet — no alarms, no bodies found. Payment scales with silence.

stages.text: Reach Warehouse 12 — the patrol works the aisle behind it.
Slip past the patrol unseen. Disguises and crouching help.
The last two won't sleep. Drop them.
Hide at least one body so it's never found.

side_rooftops.title: High Road
side_rooftops.summary: Nia runs messages above the street — fire escapes, rooftops, no cameras. Prove you can climb.

stages.text: Meet Nia behind the Noir Lounge.
Courier run across the Mile — beat the clock.
Reach Level 3 to prove you've been training.

side_bait.title: Bait Car
side_bait.summary: Dex needs the CCPD's attention somewhere else. Make noise, survive three stars, deliver the car to Berth 7 while every cruiser in Cinder chases you.

stages.text: Meet Dex at Berth 7.
Take the bait car across the Docks under THREE stars. Survive 120 seconds.
Shake the heat and get to Berth 7 clean.

side_repo.title: Repo Man
side_repo.summary: Dex has a list of cars that 'forgot' their owners. Steal one, run it to Yard 4, and try not to arrive as a hood ornament.

stages.text: Meet Dex at the garage.
Steal a car — any car. Lockpick or window, Dex doesn't judge.
Run it to Yard 4 under heat. 110 seconds.

side_partner.title: Silent Partner
side_partner.summary: Mama Ruth wants your money working, not sitting. Buy into a local business — she's watching where you invest before she trusts you with more.

stages.text: See Ruth at her restaurant.
Buy into Aunt Adaeze's Noodle Stall (phone → BIZ).
Ruth is watching how you spend an afternoon. Sit in the market and be seen sitting.

side_heatmagnet.title: Heat Magnet
side_heatmagnet.summary: Nia's betting feed needs footage nobody else can get: a three-star run across the Mile, live. Get chased. Get paid.

stages.text: Meet Nia behind the Noir Lounge.
Three stars, Lounge to Plaza, 100 seconds. Cameras rolling.
Nia wants the aftermath on camera. Hold the plaza.
Get the footage back to Nia.

side_torch.title: Torch Job
side_torch.summary: Gunnar's union dispute needs punctuation: two Halcyon trucks 'lost to brake failure.' Total them. Bonus points if the block watches them burn.

stages.text: Meet Gunnar at the Haulage office.
Wreck 2 vehicles — drive them into oblivion or let them burn.
Now the refinery gate. Two charges on the pump line and be off the yard when they go.
Vale's yard boss brought friends. Hold the gate.

side_clean_wheels.title: Clean Wheels
side_clean_wheels.summary: Dex moves a 'previously loved' car for a client who needs it unrecognizable. Lift one, give it fresh paint at the garage, deliver it hot to Yard 4. Nobody asks where it came from.

stages.text: Meet Dex at the garage.
Lift a car — lockpick or window, dealer's choice.
Give it a fresh coat of paint at Dex's PAINT bay.
Deliver it to Yard 4. 120 seconds, and expect company.

side_epilogue.title: Last Call, Again
side_epilogue.summary: The lever is pulled, the tower is quiet, and Marcus is home. Ruth puts a glass on the bar like it's any other night. It isn't. One last errand for the block that raised you — then the night is yours.

stages.text: Back to Mama Ruth's. The door's open.
Hear Ruth out.
Run the block's last favor: medicine to the shelter before the bridges wake. 110 seconds.
The shelter door. Bishop takes the box. Behind you, the city. Ahead, a quiet stool at Ruth's. What kind of name do you want?

options.label: Hang it up — the block over the score
One more ride — the city still owes you
